title: Some Mandaue City fire hydrants shut off to prevent theft, MCWD says

blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu – The Metropolitan Cebu Water District (MCWD) clarified that some fire hydrants in Mandaue City found to have weak water flow during recent inspections were not necessarily defective. It explained that water supply to these hydrants had been shut off to prevent unauthorized water extraction. MCWD said it had received reports of water delivery trucks drawing water directly from fire hydrants without prior coordination or authorization from the water district.
